identitySignals: Agenda names 'Office Depot, LLC' of Boca Raton, FL; the official Office Depot website states its copyright holder is 'Office Depot, LLC'
SEC proxy filing lists Office Depot, LLC as an operating company of The ODP Corporation, headquartered at 6600 North Military Trail, Boca Raton, Florida, matching the agenda location
Office Depot sells office supplies, matching OUSD's 'Office Supplies, Related Products and Services' piggyback contract through OMNIA Partners
research.notes: Address is the principal executive office of parent The ODP Corporation (SEC filing); it is the Boca Raton headquarters where Office Depot, LLC is based. Phone is the customer service line shown on officedepot.com, not the corporate main line. No EIN, CA entity number or SAM UEI cited.
